_note: avenCITY dome units — v0.3. Domes are the only ownable assets (via SPARKminds); the land under them belongs to the CITY SPARK (biomes.json). Every dome has per-day NEEDS that scale with its level — higher levels produce more and consume more. levelMultiplier applies to production batches AND the dividend stream.

buildCosts._note: Materials bought at open-market prices by the City Treasury when a spark funds. Costs per level are cumulative upgrades of the shell.

needsPerDay._note: What a dome consumes to keep running, per game day, BY LEVEL — bought at market by its Aven. Grows with level: scale ambition, scale appetite.

income: residential rent (dome sets the price, residents choose)

upgradeVerticals._note: Independent LV.1-5 tracks per dome, paid from dome treasury or a new SPARKmind raise (dilution). Cost: 60 HEARTS x current level per step, spent buying materials/services at market.

sparks.dividends: stream in real time, pro-rata per SPARKmind, scaled by levelMultiplier
